data_quality.original_record_fields: The first 672 raw records chiefly preserve name, country/city, rank, source category and country or region page URL; all 672 have detail_url=null. No individual spot-level coordinates, subarea information, hours, crowd, or warnings were systematically extracted into scrape_1.json.

data_quality.user_listing_standard: Each accepted location later needs Where:, Best times:, Crowd:, Watch out:, grounded latitude/longitude and map links, Last_Updated actual edit date, and truthful distinct supporting-source count.
data_quality.classification_notes: Some city lists contain dedicated gay saunas, clubs, bars, sex businesses and ambiguous cases. Preserve these as raw evidence but exclude from cruising-area proposals when they belong in regular venues. Public/ordinary managed places remain research leads only. The site top lists are not complete interactive-map inventories.
data_quality.source_recency: Search engine cached crawl and a site comment/check-in do not independently establish operational status or typical crowd in 2026. Don't collect personal profiles, check-ins or live user data.

follow_up_order: From the ten zero-covered priority city index lists, follow individual public location pages to capture exact subarea, reported times, warnings, possible crowd description, and GPS using directions links. Preserve detail URLs and source excerpts as notes; independently verify before listing.
Cross-match every discovered place with all existing Backroom live/held/flagged cruising areas and proposals from scrapes 1-8, including spelling and park subsection variants.
Exclude dedicated gay sex and nightlife businesses from cruising-area proposals, but keep source findings as raw records; verify ordinary managed-public places cautiously.
If material details are missing, use one or two supplementary sources as needed, not every research site.
After the ten zero cities, review the remaining seven priority cities absent from Scrape 1, giving priority to those with fewer existing known places.
For 32 priority cities represented only through national top lists, selectively check city pages where content appears materially incomplete; do not redo identical source records.
Maintain separately marked blocked country pages; use alternative accessible websites without assuming zero.
Once complete, update master only with deduplicated new proposals, not raw category counts. Do not touch production listings.json.
